params.name: geom
params.doc: The geometry: WKB, EWKB, WKT or EWKT, in EPSG:27700 metres.

params.name: resolution
params.doc: BNG resolution: an index (1 to 6, negative for a quadrant) or a size such as `'1km'` or `'100m'`.

params.name: k
params.doc: The number of rings of dilation around the geometry's cells.

params.name: mode
params.doc: The dilation mode: `'boundary-out'`, `'boundary-in'`, `'boundary-in-ignore-holes'`, `'hole-in'`, `'hole-out'` or `'hole-out-ignore-geom'`.

params.name: coverage
params.doc: How a cell belongs to the geometry: `'coveras'` (it overlaps), `'polyfill'` (its centre is inside) or `'core'` (it is inside).

params.doc: The value burned for the cell. A repeated cell burns its largest value.

params.doc: Not read: the output is always EPSG:27700.

params.name: pixel_size
params.doc: The pixel size in metres.

params.doc: The west edge of the canvas in EPSG:27700 metres.

params.name: ymin
params.doc: The south edge of the canvas in EPSG:27700 metres.

params.doc: The east edge of the canvas in EPSG:27700 metres.

params.doc: The north edge of the canvas in EPSG:27700 metres.

params.doc: The canvas width in pixels.

params.name: height
params.doc: The canvas height in pixels.

params.doc: How the canvas is derived when no extent is given, for example `'centroids'`.

params.name: kring_pad
params.doc: Cells of padding around the derived canvas.

params.doc: Must be NULL. Reproject the tile with `gbx_rst_transformcrs` instead.

doc.summary: Rasterize a group's BNG cells into one tile (pixel-centroid burn).

params.name: tile
params.doc: The tiles of the group.

doc.summary: Merge a group's tile rasters into one mosaic tile.
doc.returns: The merged raster over the union extent, or NULL for an empty group.

params.name: tiles
params.doc: The input tiles. Band 1 of each tile binds to `A`, `B`, `C` and so on, in array order.

params.name: expression
params.doc: The expression: a JSON envelope with a `calc` key, or a bare expression such as `'(A - B) / (A + B)'`.

doc.summary: Apply a map-algebra expression across an array of tiles.
doc.returns: A single-band Float32 tile on the georeference of the first tile.

params.name: tile
params.doc: The tile to split.

params.name: tile_width
params.doc: The sub-tile width in pixels.

params.name: tile_height
params.doc: The sub-tile height in pixels.

doc.summary: Partition a tile into non-overlapping sub-tiles of the given pixel size.
doc.returns: One row per sub-tile; the edge tiles are smaller when the size does not divide the raster.

params.name: tile
params.doc: The single-band DEM tile.

params.name: unit
params.doc: `'degrees'` or `'percent'`.

params.name: xscale
params.doc: Vertical units per horizontal unit along x; set it with `yscale`. When both are NULL, the scale comes from the raster CRS.

params.name: yscale
params.doc: Vertical units per horizontal unit along y; set it with `xscale`.

params.doc: The target CRS: an authority code such as `'EPSG:3857'` or `'ESRI:54008'`, WKT, PROJJSON or PROJ4. An integer string is an EPSG code.

doc.summary: Reproject the raster to a target CRS given as a string.
doc.returns: The tile reprojected to the target CRS.
